Privacy Policy

Last Updated: August 15, 2026

Important Note for Parents & Guardians: Kids Matcher! is designed as a family-friendly educational puzzle game. We comply strictly with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) children's safety rules.

1. Introduction

This privacy policy governs your use of the mobile application Kids Matcher! (package ID: com.vishalgupta.kidswordmatch), created by developer Vishal Gupta. The app is an educational matching game featuring Shadow, ABC, and Counting puzzle layouts designed for young children.

2. User Data Collection

We do not collect, request, store, or transmit any personally identifiable information (PII) from children or users. The application operates entirely locally on your device. Specifically:

  • No accounts or registrations are required to use the app.
  • We do not collect names, email addresses, phone numbers, or locations.
  • We do not record speech audio from the voice synthesis features (all pronunciations are generated directly on-device using local Web Speech APIs).

3. Local Storage & App State

The application stores basic game state values locally on your device's sandbox container using browser localStorage. This data includes:

  • Your current level progress index (e.g. Level 3 of Shadow Match).
  • Your current earned stars count.
  • Your sound toggle preference (active/inactive).

This data remains on your device and is not sent to any external server. You can clear this data at any time by clearing the application cache in your Android settings.

4. Advertising & Third-Party SDKs

Our app integrates the Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) SDK to display banner ads at the bottom of the screen. To comply with family safety guidelines:

  • Non-Personalized Ads (NPA): All ad requests sent to AdMob are marked as child-directed. Google AdMob will serve only non-personalized ads to users.
  • Device Identifiers: Google AdMob may collect and process device identifiers, cookies, and other parameters to serve ads, prevent fraud, and handle analytics. These identifiers are processed according to Google’s Privacy Policy.

5. Children's Privacy (COPPA Compliance)

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 13. If a parent or guardian becomes aware that their child has provided us with information without their consent, they should contact us immediately so we can delete such data.

6. Contact Us

If you have any questions regarding privacy while using the application, or have questions about our practices, please contact us via email at:
